description_localkey: A rabid gun nut who thinks about nothing else. She is from Counters, but her true identity as a spy is an open secret.

element_details.element_desc_localekey: Injects Code: H.S.T.A. to all wind-type enemies, dealing 10% additional damage.

piece_detail.description_localkey:
Used for a Nikke's Limit Break.
Spare Bodies for a fully enhanced Nikke will be converted into Body Labels.

shot_detail.description_localkey:

<color=#00AEFF>Deals {damage}% of ATK as damage.
Deals {core_damage_rate}% damage when attacking core.</color>

skill2_detail.description_localkey: ■ Activates at the beginning of Full Burst. Affects all allies. <color=#00AEFF> Critical Rate ▲ {description_value_01}% for {description_value_02} shots.</color>

skill1_detail.description_localkey:
■  Activates when defeating an enemy. Affects the {description_value_01} ally unit(s) with the highest <word_group=10025>final</word_group> ATK.

ulti_skill_detail.description_localkey:

squad_detail.squad_description:
A ragtag squad led by a rookie Commander who just graduated from the military academy. 
Stationed in the Outpost, they take on all manner of assignments.

character_dialog_group_list.speech_localkey: More firepower for a brighter tomorrow!
The only thing standing between us and the enemy, is our firepower!
Firepower is the be all and end all!
Let's go, Master! Bigger and better firepower awaits us!
Master, I just know that one day I'll find a legendary weapon that can hold the bullets I make. Do you think so too?

After being around you, my firepower has gotten stronger!
And I'm definitely gonna stick around in the future.
Master, now is the time for action, not relaxation!
Is sitting here quietly one of your secret methods of boosting our firepower?
When are the showers going to be running again?
This place is fantastic, I can shoot as much as I want.
Why does our dorm look more like a warehouse?
I'm Neon, and firepower is my game!
There's nothing I won't do for greater firepower.
I would give up my finest ammo for you.
I'm starting to feel the sparks between us!
You've taught me well Master. I'll repay you by putting my firepower to good use!
Time to put my firepower to the test.
My firepower... just couldn't cut it.
Nothing can stand against my firepower!
